Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Top-down industrial game. Observed controls: WASD moves, J mines the entity under the pointer, F collects nearby floating pickups, E toggles inventory/crafting, T toggles research, and Escape closes panels or opens the game menu. Mining requires the pointer to highlight a valid target and sustained J; progress is shown by the bar above the quickbar. Wreck tooltips identify size, broken state, storage, and health. The crash site was cleared: the initial spaceship yielded 8 firearm magazines, while other wrecks yielded iron plates totaling 8. Some empty or small wrecks vanished without visible pickups. Inventory observed: burner mining drill (0.25/s, 2x2 area, fuel-powered), stone furnace, wood fuel, 8 iron plates, plus weapon and magazine quickbar items. Crafting showed a transport belt needing an iron plate and iron gear wheel. Electronics is available and requires crafting 10 copper plates, but clicks on Start research did not queue it. A green stone furnace was placed or opened; its UI showed no fuel. Minimap red dots appear to mark copper ore, but clicking them did not move the character. Reaching a copper field showed highlighted ore and a large resource count, yet J reported "Cannot reach." A highlighted tree yielded a wood-mining progress of 14, then became a dead grey trunk with 2 wood expected, but repeated movement, map clicks, and J attempts left "Cannot reach" unresolved. Guess: wood can fuel machines, and the drill/furnace must be fueled and correctly placed to obtain copper ore and smelt plates; not yet verified.
